implementation.reason: Read ReportingHandler.run, document snapshot/check semantics, production/test diff. Existing validator added after current and memory/knowledge checks, immediately before handler; exception and current-False semantics retained.

reference_boundary.reason: Independent fixtures use real documents/snapshots and direct handler-call oracle, not outcome alone. Both invalidation and compatibility boundaries tested.

data_integrity.reason: Read all supplied raw logs and independent outputs; retained fixture error distinguished from corrected baseline; frozen source/test hashes match before reporting.

numerical_sanity.reason: Reliability behavior only, no numerical algorithm or metric; exact integer call counts checked.

measurement_validity.reason: No performance claim; elapsed unittest timings are incidental and not compared.

reproducibility.reason: Actual baseline source loaded from git show into an isolated interpreter module; no production source rewrite. Independent candidate rerun with normal and optimized interpreters.

limitations: Only the deterministic callback invalidation window and listed fixtures are accepted; arbitrary concurrent changes after the final check remain a TOCTOU gap.
Extra project document traversal/read/hash cost is unmeasured.
